tuiBehaviour: Workspaces and Open dialogs render the empty list, create toasts "Creating workspace failed", delete shows "Failed to delete worktree" (packages/tui/src/component/dialog-workspaces.tsx:83,244,296,357,363; dialog-open.tsx:122,133; prompt/move.tsx:41,59)
reason: The bridge has no checkout manager: a senpi session is bound to one cwd, not to a worktree set. DELETE has no shim, so the router answers 405 MethodNotAllowedError before any handler runs.

tuiBehaviour: Terminal panes stay hidden behind capabilities.persistentPty:false, a direct create answers ServiceUnavailableError and an attach answers PtyNotFoundError (packages/tui/src/context/session-terminals.tsx:37,73,104; component/terminal-pane.tsx:182,189)
reason: senpi has no PTY service, so no terminal can exist: the empty list matches the declared shape and the declared not-found error is the truthful attach answer.

tuiBehaviour: The migration overlay stays closed: the poll loop returns on status completed and only renders on running (packages/tui/src/component/migration-overlay.tsx:22)
reason: The bridge starts from an empty state directory; there is no V1 history to migrate.

tuiBehaviour: The "Last turn" source renders no files, exactly like a turn that changed nothing (packages/tui/src/feature-plugins/system/diff-viewer.tsx:84,147-152,185)
reason: The endpoint answers a turn's diff from per-turn file snapshots; senpi records none, and the bridge's vcs.diff compares the working tree with HEAD, a different range.

tuiBehaviour: /models lists the host's models once a provider is connected, and /connect lists each connected provider with its credential (packages/tui/src/component/use-connected.tsx:7; component/dialog-model.tsx:46-49; component/dialog-integration.tsx:109,161)
reason: senpi has no integration registry, but the bridge projects real state: the host's model catalog plus key material in the agent directory's auth.json.

tuiBehaviour: Key and external connect show the error inline; OAuth and command flows toast the declared error and fall back to the connect view (packages/tui/src/component/dialog-integration.tsx:372,423,431,478,513,568,617,698,729,766,780; dialog-go-upsell.tsx:285,332)
reason: Connecting or starting an attempt would flip user-visible state. No credential store and no attempt runner exist, so the declared IntegrationNotFoundError / IntegrationAttemptNotFoundError answers are the only honest refusals.

tuiBehaviour: Activate, rename and delete toast InvalidRequestError kind unsupported; the dialog does not pretend the credential changed (packages/tui/src/component/dialog-integration.tsx:232,254,271)
reason: The bridge stores no credentials, so a 204 would silently fake a credential switch.

tuiBehaviour: The pair dialog fails as a whole instead of rendering links with no code (packages/tui/src/component/dialog-pair.tsx:22,114)
reason: Pairing hands a browser the server password; the bridge is attached through --server with Basic auth, so there is no pairing code or session to create.

tuiBehaviour: /usage shows the signed-out copy and no budget warnings (packages/tui/src/component/usage.tsx:37,122,125)
reason: senpi has no OpenCode Console workspace, so the location is not signed in; null is part of the endpoint's declared success type.

tuiBehaviour: /mcps lists one row per server named in the host's mcp.json plus the project's .opencode/mcp.json, each labelled with its last-known status: "Connected ✓" when the discovery cache holds an entry, "Connecting …" while pending, "Disabled ○" when the config disables it; the toggle sends disconnect on a connected row and connect on any other non-pending row, both answered 204 NoContent without changing the row, and devtools resource rows stay empty (packages/tui/src/component/dialog-mcp.tsx:21-33,46,124; component/devtools-bar.tsx:204)
reason: The bridge projects the list from the host's mcp.json and the project's .opencode/mcp.json, merged by name, and reads each status from cache/mcp-cache.json without a live probe: connected only when the cache holds an entry, disabled when the config sets disabled: true, pending otherwise. There is no MCP connection lifecycle, so connect and disconnect are not routed and answer 204 NoContent, and /api/mcp/resource serves no catalog.

tuiBehaviour: /plugins lists only the builtins and the home footer's failed counter stays at 0 (packages/tui/src/plugin/context.tsx:540; feature-plugins/system/plugins.tsx:36; feature-plugins/home/footer.tsx:59)
reason: senpi loads no package or local plugins, so the empty inventory is the truthful answer instead of the 404 the TUI hit at startup.

tuiBehaviour: The client stores whatever saved rules exist, which is empty until a reply picks "always" (packages/client/src/solid/data.ts:2030)
reason: senpi approvals are per-request. The bridge answers from its own in-memory "always" replies, and the PATCH and DELETE routes are not mounted.

tuiBehaviour: Home shows no pending forms unless an engine frame filed one (packages/tui/src/routes/home.tsx:38; routes/session/index.tsx:215)
reason: Forms are state-backed from extension_ui_request frames, not a degraded empty.

tuiBehaviour: The agent picker lists the single Build agent, primary and visible, whose id every projected message carries (packages/tui/src/context/local.tsx:60)
reason: senpi has no agent registry and no per-session agent switch, so the bridge projects the one agent it models instead of an empty list.
